purpose: Cutie calibration of component cleanup and one global quality gate; continuous first-frame-seeded inference, no query masks/identities supplied
sampling: Decode exact original frame indices at two frames per second; FFV1 lossless clip verified by every decoded frame hash; SDK vid_stride=1
object_identity: Cutie object IDs1–8 converted to original zero-based slots only when serializing; never reassigned
initialization: First source frame only: existing CPU SAM2.1 tiny1024 masks from publisher boxes emulate precise farmer prompts. Overlapping pixels go to the first original mask. Names1–6;7/8remain anonymous. No future masks, boxes or labels supplied to inference.
metrics: correct names over all visible known animals
limits: Already exposed development footage only; final windows remain closed.
Oracle first-frame boxes plus SAM masks are manual initialization, not automatic enrollment.
Bounding-box annotations do not measure segmentation IoU.
No detector introduces newly arriving cows and no appearance encoder reacquires lost identities.
No intermediate manual corrections or condition selection from query labels.
Stop and preserve an incomplete diagnostic if driver allocation or process peak RSS exceeds8GiB, or sustained post-startup processing exceeds1second/frame.
Cutie receives explicit first-frame SAM masks; SAM video used box prompts. This is not a pure architecture A/B.

Calibration labels may choose the fixed operating point only after inference; reserved1800–2099 and2700–2999 remain unopened. Indexed original masks are cached at every integer second for inference-free audits.
configuration: Upstream generic eval_config, shortest edge480 (640x480 for this source), long-term enabled,mem_every5,all otherSDKdefaults.

quality_control.component_tie: Largest pixel area; ties choose smallest component label from OpenCV row-major labeling. No score/truth enters transformation.
quality_control.quality: 10th percentile of assigned-object probability over original SDK mask, before component cleanup
quality_control.decision: Inclusive quality >= threshold permits original seeded name; otherwise retain the predicted box with unknown name. Anonymous seed slots never gain names.
quality_control.selection: Maximize correct known coverage subject to conservative named precision>=.99 and unknown false naming<=.01 on1230–1529 only; tie higher precision then raw boxes then lower threshold. If no condition qualifies, no promotion.
quality_control.denominator: Every visible enrolled animal including missed/rejected frames; all named unmatched boxes remain errors.

resource_policy: After each completed inference, synchronize and release unused Metal cache if driver allocation exceeds6GiB; stop if remaining driver or peak process RSS exceeds8GiB. Cleanup and PNG/statistic caching count in frame time.
